omar_account_exec: Heads-up — Board-level check-in with HelixCorp tomorrow. CISO wants final signoff on KMS, SLA, and data egress before execs greenlight procurement. Can we get a short internal runbook and clear asks by EOD?
sophia_sales: On it. I have the call at 10:00 PT. Asking HelixCorp for specifics right now (what fields do they need in the DPA).
devon_se: Quick technical summary I can drop into the runbook: Redwood supports customer-managed KMS (Cloud KMS/HSM), all egress encrypted TLS1.3, optional VPC peering + private endpoints for Dedicated. We can provide per-tenant audit logs.
devon_se: sample snippet for KMS policy they asked to preview:
```
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" 
  member = "serviceAccount:redwood-inference@PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
  role   = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
```
mira_support: I can stand up a short-lived Dedicated trial in their us-west1 region for validation — 48h environment with identical network paths. Need a PO or signed NDA?
sophia_sales: HelixCorp already sent an NDA earlier today, attaching it to the thread (link). We can ask legal what they need to sign to get trial creds.
luis_legal: NDA looks standard. For trial access to a dedicated environment we need the minimal DPA + SOW addendum. I'll draft the addendum by EOD and share for quick review.
julia_ciso: I'm on the HelixCorp call tomorrow. Need: SOC2 report (latest Type II), encryption-at-rest details (algorithms/keystore), KMS integration diagram, and the SLA with RTO/RPO and credit matrix. Please avoid vague wording.
ryan_eng_infra: SLA snapshot: 99.95% monthly uptime for Dedicated with 30s P95 p99 latency targets on benchmarked workloads. RTO for regional failover is 15m with cross-region warm standby (configurable). Will put a one-page summary into the runbook.
devon_se: Also note fallback policy: if primary model pool is unavailable, requests auto-route to a compatible lower-cost variant (configurable per customer). That matters if they ask about graceful degradation.
omar_account_exec: Great — please prioritize the SOC2 and the one-pager SLA. @julia_ciso any additional redlines we should anticipate from their security team?
julia_ciso: They will likely ask about key rotation cadence, key exportability (we do not allow raw key export), and proofs for access control (who holds keys, MFA for key ops). Add an ops contact for on-call escalations.
sophia_sales: HelixCorp wants pricing clarity too — they asked about transit egress charges for heavy embedding pipelines. Can someone confirm expected egress billing model for Dedicated + peering?
yan-placeholder: (removed message)
ryan_eng_infra: For Dedicated with VPC peering, no public egress charges from Redwood for inter-region traffic over peering; standard cloud egress applies for cross-cloud transfers. I'll include an example cost calc for a 1TB/month embedding workload.
mira_support: Deploy-bot: provisioning started for helix-dedicated-trial-177400 at 2023-06-12T18:12Z. Expect environment ready in ~45m.
deploy-bot: ✅ helix-dedicated-trial-177400 provisioning: 3/4 steps complete. ETA 28m. Logs: https://internal.redwood/deploys/helix-177400
oliver-not-present: (trimmed)
omar_account_exec: Thanks everyone. I'll prep the exec note with a short TL;DR: SOC2 + KMS diagram + SLA page + trial link + cost estimate. If legal and infra can get drafts in this thread by 16:30 PT, I can finalize before the 10:00 PT call tomorrow.
luis_legal: Will post DPA addendum draft by 15:30 PT.
devon_se: I'll upload the KMS diagram and encryption details by 16:00 PT.
julia_ciso: I'll review and provide redlines asap; if anything blocks signoff I'll flag before 18:00 PT.
mira_support: Trial env created and creds sent to helix-security@helixcorp (masked) — ping me if they need port allowlist or jumpbox.
sophia_sales: Perfect. Omar — leaning on you to run through the TL;DR at the board call. Tag me if they push pricing hard and I’ll jump in. :thumbsup:
omar_account_exec: Will do. If anyone needs direct escalation to an exec sponsor, ping me and I’ll loop in VP Sales.
